# hungovercoders

> Folk tales of working in tech from the South Wales valleys. Built with the AI on the team and the dog on the sofa. Honest walkthroughs, strong opinions a model couldn't form, and the occasional Sunday-morning hangover.

hungovercoders is the personal site of dataGriff — a technical product manager and principal engineer writing about full-stack development, data engineering, DevOps and building with AI. The site publishes blog posts, hands-on training series sourced from sibling `learn.*` repositories, and project write-ups.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://hungovercoders.com/blog): All posts, newest first
- [slopstopper CLI and tooling](https://hungovercoders.com/blog/2026-06-21-slopstopper-cli-and-tooling): The quality pipeline behind this site
- [Simplify Python package development with uv and Taskfile](https://hungovercoders.com/blog/2025-08-15-simplify-python-package-development-with-uv-and-taskfile): A modern Python packaging walkthrough
- [Distributed reporting mesh with DuckDB and Streamlit](https://hungovercoders.com/blog/2024-10-20-distributed-reporting-mesh-with-duckdb-and-streamlit): A lightweight analytics pattern

## Training

- [Training index](https://hungovercoders.com/training): Hands-on tutorial series, each sourced from a `learn.*` repository

## Projects

- [Projects index](https://hungovercoders.com/projects): Things built and shipped
- [slopstopper](https://hungovercoders.com/projects/slopstopper): The portable quality pipeline that gates this repo
- [dogadopt](https://hungovercoders.com/projects/dogadopt): Bringing every UK rescue's dogs into one place

## About

- [About](https://hungovercoders.com/about): Who dataGriff is and what this site is for
